name: BoldSign
description: BoldSign is a comprehensive electronic signature solution designed to streamline the signing process for businesses and individuals. It offers a secure and efficient way to manage and execute documents online.

events.d: Create a new contact in BoldSign with email, full name, phone number, job title, and company.
Retrieve a paginated list of contacts (10 per page). Use the 'page' parameter to view other pages.
Sends a notification to viaSocket whenever a new draft is created in BoldSign.
Send a document through BoldSign to request signatures and notify viaSocket when the document is sent.
Create a new template in BoldSign for document signing; prepares the document and can trigger the TemplateCreated webhook.
Send a BoldSign template and trigger the 'Sent' webhook to notify viaSocket.
Sends a notification to viaSocket when a BoldSign document is revoked (Revoked webhook event).
Sends a webhook to viaSocket when a BoldSign document is declined so workflows can respond to the decline.
Triggers when a document is Completed.
